definitions.full: H8524. talal תָּלוּל adjective exalted, lofty (properly Qal Participle pass ); — ות ׳הַרגָּֿבֹהַּ Ezek 17:22 a high and lofty mountain

occurrences.englishText: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
